prompt:
A German woman in her fifties stands on a Berlin pavement beside a pedestrian
traffic light, seen from the waist up, three quarters turned to her left,
right of centre in a vertical frame. A plain dark coat, a shopping bag over
one arm. Her face is indignant and polite at once. Behind her the pavement
runs on with parked bicycles and a plain pale building front. Daylight,
overcast and even. She looks at a point beyond the left edge of the frame and
does not face the camera.
